title: Shape the sound library
question: Which structure best supports finding and managing sounds? Each keeps the existing Soundscape visual language.

options.label: Collection and intake
options.thesis: Browse the collection alongside a dedicated place for recent imports and unfinished organization.
options.viewport: A searchable sound list shares the screen with a recent-imports and organizing panel.
options.risk: The intake panel takes room even when imports are infrequent.

options.label: List and inspector
options.thesis: Keep the collection front and center; select a sound to inspect, edit and audition it.
options.viewport: A searchable, filterable sound list sits next to a contextual sound inspector.
options.risk: Details require selecting a sound before editing.

options.label: Artwork shelf
options.thesis: Find sounds visually in a browsable grid with quick preview and contextual details.
options.viewport: Filters lead into an image-first collection with preview controls and a selected-sound panel.
options.risk: A large library is less information-dense than a list.
